messages:
Ana: Quick sync — need a scrub of the competitive messaging + inbound routing for the launch webinar. Goal: one-pager for SDRs, benchmark soundbites for webinar, routing rules for ops. Can we triage today? :eyes:

Mike: On it. Can you share the benchmark deck / top 3 claims?

Ana: Dropping the deck here: https://drive.redwood/benchmarks/2026-q1 — headline numbers in the summary slide. Top 3 claims I want to keep in play: predictable unit economics, unified runtime across private/dedicated/hosted, reliable fallback routing.

Ravi: Agree on the three. Suggest we avoid framing as just "cheaper" vs cloud — instead: "consistent cost per request at scale" + a note about ops levers (batching, cache).

Jess: For the SDR one-pager I'll do: 1) 2-line positioning 2) top 3 objection responses 3) competitor callouts (cloud AI, LLM API, infra vendors) with 1-sentence rebuttals. Will draft by EOD.

Olivia: Webinar hook idea: 30s customer story show-and-tell — latency SLOs + cost delta chart. We should also have 3 crisp benchmark soundbites (p50, p95, throughput at 4k context).

Mike: On routing: ops, can we pattern-match inbound leads and route to SDR vs AE vs Solutions? Example rules below — can we implement?

Ops: yes we can do regex-based routing. Send the rules and we'll stage them.

Mike: ```
# inbound routing prototype
routes:
  - pattern: ".*benchmark.*|latency|throughput"
    owner: SDR
    target: sdr@redwood.com
  - pattern: ".*enterprise|sla|private deployment|vpc"
    owner: AE
    target: ae-enterprise@redwood.com
  - pattern: ".*on-prem|air-gapped|hsm|compliance"
    owner: Solutions
    target: solutions@redwood.com
```

benchmark-bot: new benchmark upload complete (2026-03-22). Summary: p50 ~20% lower than CloudX on same model/seq when running dedicated pool; p95 improvements depend on batching config. Full methodology: https://drive.redwood/benchmarks/2026-q1/methodology

Ravi: Nice. Make sure every soundbite includes an explicit methodology caveat: "run on dedicated pools with quantization profile X" so we don't get into claim disputes. Also add a migration note for customers on managed cloud endpoints.

Ana: Next steps: @Jess make SDR one-pager draft by EOD; @Olivia write the 30s webinar hooks + 3 soundbites; @Ops spin the routing rules to staging and confirm; @Mike prepare 2 A/B subject lines for invites.

Ops: Routing staged and smoke-tested in dev. Will push to staging at 15:00 PST and can promote to prod after 24h smoke window.

Mike: Subject lines (draft): A) "Run LLMs the way you ship services" B) "Lower inference cost, predictable latency" — vote?

Olivia: I prefer B for paid/social, A for webinar invite copy.

Ana: Solid. We'll review the SDR one-pager and hooks at 16:00. Thanks team :rocket:
